docs.text: 部署mkdocs mkdocs build git init git add . git commit -m "Deploy site" git remote add origin https://github.com/your-username/your-repo.git git branch -M gh-pages git push -u origin gh-pages --force 遇到问题 Permission denied (publickey). 解决： ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your_email@example.com" eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 将公钥添加到 GitHub 账户 ssh -T git@github.com git push -u origin gh-pages --force 遇到问题 gitpage仅显示根目录下的readme，没有显示site/ 解决： 调整 mkdocs.yml 配置 site_name: My Docs repo_url: https://github.com/your-username/your-repo docs_dir: docs site_dir: site mkdocs build --clean mkdocs gh-deploy --force github-setting-pages-branch: /root
